children.description: These reactions illustrate HCl reacting with Zinc to evolve hydrogen gas, and with Sodium Carbonate to produce carbon dioxide via brisk effervescence. The reaction with Sodium Hydroxide is a classic neutralization process, forming sodium chloride and water, typically identified using a phenolphthalein indicator to observe the color change.
